result.keyword: Who are the best luxury real estate agencies in Mornington Peninsula? Give me a shortlist of specific prestige property agencies with reasons.

items.markdown:
Leading luxury real estate agencies on the Mornington Peninsula include Peninsula Sotheby's International Realty, [Kay & Burton](https://www.kayburton.com.au/) , and Marshall White . These firms specialize in high-end coastal retreats, multi-million dollar acreages, and premium beachfront architecture.

### Top Prestige Property Agencies

- **Peninsula Sotheby's International Realty** : Offers unmatched global reach and local expertise across high-end pockets like Sorrento, Portsea, and Mount Eliza. Best for connecting luxury local properties with international ultra-high-net-worth buyers through an exclusive worldwide network.[[1]](https://coastalagents.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVc1bk56TmtNWGMxGAo)
- **Kay & Burton** : A premier Victorian heritage luxury brand with a dedicated Mornington Peninsula presence. Best for intergenerational client relationships, discreet private wealth advisory, and high-end lifestyle or rural holdings.[[1]](https://www.kayburton.com.au/)
- **Marshall White** : Brings a powerhouse Melbourne luxury pedigree (particularly from Stonnington and Boroondara) directly to Peninsula hotspots like Mount Eliza and Mornington. Best for high-impact auction campaigns and sophisticated metro-buyer pipelines.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVc1bk56TmtNWGMxGAo)
- **Jellis Craig Mornington / Mount Martha** : Highly regarded for deep local roots and dominant market share in coastal corridors. Best for precise, data-driven local valuations and premium contemporary family residences.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVc1bk56TmtNWGMxGAo)
- **Buxton Mornington Peninsula** : Operates specialized regional offices (including Flinders, Sorrento, and Mount Eliza) handling elite coastal architecture and country estates. Best for localized, multi-office regional reach across diverse micro-markets.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEdOZmQzSXdYdxgK)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVc1bk56TmtNWGMxGAo)
